Full-Stack Web Application (.NET & Razor)


Development of a complete web solution with client-server architecture. Design and development of a high-performance RESTful API in C# (.NET) and integration of a dynamic user interface using the Razor view engine.

Client-server architecture
RESTful API in C#
API call management and SQL data structuring

Server Infrastructure & Cloud Integration


Deployment of secure virtualized environments to support multi-user services. Deployment and configuration of Windows Server environments with PowerShell automation. Integration of Azure services for high availability.

Secure virtualized environments
PowerShell automation
Technical documentation (recovery plans, security)


Technologies


Azure Windows Server Active Directory PowerShell VMware





Personal Website with CI/CD


Design and deployment of this personal website with an automated continuous integration and deployment pipeline (CI/CD).


Key points
